'''''Koh-Lanta: Palawan''''' was the seventh season of the [[France|French]] version of ''[[Survivor (franchise)|Survivor]]'', [[Koh-Lanta]]. This season took place in [[Philippines]] in [[Palawan]], and was broadcast on [[TF1]] from June 29, 2007 to September 11, 2007 airing on Fridays at 6:55&nbsp;p.m.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.parismatch.com/Vivre/Voyage/Philippines-Koh-Lanta-a-l-epreuve-du-reve-136099|title=Philippines. Koh-Lanta, à l'épreuve du rêve.|first=Anne-Laure|last=Le Gall|date=July 12, 2007|website=Paris Match}}</ref> The two original tribes this season were Batang and Guntao. Due to the voluntary exits of Ali and Andrien, both Grégoire and Pascale re-entered the competition after their initial eliminations. This season, like in [[Koh-Lanta: Bocas del Toro|Bocas del Toro]], both finalists received three jury votes and were both given the titles of Survivor.

The winners of this season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]'' were Jade Handi and Kevin Cuoco who split the prize of €110,000 after tying in the final tribal council with a 3-3 jury vote.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ladepeche.fr/article/2007/10/16/61107-television-jade-raconte-les-dessous-de-koh-lanta.html|title=Toulouse. Télévision. Jade raconte les dessous de Koh-Lanta|first=Emmanuelle|last=Rey|date=October 16, 2007|website=La Dépêche du Midi}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.leparisien.fr/culture-loisirs/kevin-et-jade-duo-gagnant-de-koh-lanta-12-09-2007-2008371043.php|title=Kevin et Jade, duo gagnant de " Koh-Lanta "|first=Catherine|last=Balle|date=September 12, 2007|website=Le Parisien}}</ref>

===Future appearances===
* Filomène Fortes and Jade Handi returned for ''[[Koh-Lanta: Le Retour des Héros]]''.
* Grégoire Delachaux returned for ''[[Koh-Lanta: Le Choc des Héros]]'', which Delachaux won. 
* Handi returned for a third time in ''[[Koh-Lanta: La Légende]]''.
